case_number: 2025 INSC 423; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SLP(CIVIL) NO.26654 OF 2023)

parties.respondent: District Deputy Registrar, Co-Operative Societies (3), Mumbai & Ors.

summary: Dispute over unilateral assignment of leasehold rights under Maharashtra Ownership of Flats Act, 1963; first application rejected due to legal uncertainties with direction to approach civil court; second application filed without civil court resolution granted by competent authority; challenge to maintainability, res judicata, and jurisdictional overreach; High Court dismissed writ petition; issue of whether second application barred by prior order and amounted to review; statutory limits on quasi-judicial authority; unauthorized construction and area demarcation disputes; conflicting interpretations of liberty to reapply.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Ownership of Flats (Regulation of the Promotion of Construction, Sale, Management and Transfer) Act, 1963 s.5
Maharashtra Ownership of Flats (Regulation of the Promotion of Construction, Sale, Management and Transfer) Act, 1963 s.11
